_doc: COHERENCE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): 'all surfaces, all files, all code, all instructions, everything has to work together automatically and seamlessly from the beginning.' Read by foundation/coherence.py. Each generated surface names its one source and its generator; every instruction surface is linted for phrases that contradict the closed-loop axiom; every rule in agents/AGENTS.md must name code that enforces it and must reach the seed copy unless it is listed platform-only. Baselines are shrink-only: an entry may be removed when it is fixed, never added.

sources.synced_by: each copy repository's agent-files workflow pulls the generator from main daily and opens a pull request its lane merges

sources._repo_only_why: kit-sync bookkeeping and the template repository's own legal and security notices; TEMPLATE-CODE-ONLY-1 keeps company terms out of seed/

sources.synced_by: python3 -m foundation coherence --gen --apply (repos entries for every tenant whose repository exists)

contradictions.why: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: human-approval controls are replaced by automated gates

contradictions.pattern: protected change with a human reviewer
contradictions.why: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: a legal act is a gate card with a default in effect, not a waiting review
SELF-CLOSED-LOOPS-1: nothing waits on a person reading
MERGE-NOW: a green PR merges itself

contradictions.pattern: List the records still to be created and by whom
contradictions.why: IC-ACTOR-001: the fleet is the actor of every next step
CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: no person merges; the lane does

_platform_only_why.INTENT-YIELD-1: scores the platform owner's own directives in this file; a seeded system has its own owner and its own directives file
